what_to_detect: The dash static (has haste as long as its dash cost was paid) contributes haste to a permanent whose dash cost was paid.
near_miss: The dash static contributes nothing, because the permanent was cast for its mana cost.
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
continuous_contribution keywords haste alone matches every haste-granting static

what_to_detect: A card's dash-cost cast is a candidate whose dash cost is affordable.
near_miss: A dash-cost candidate that is not affordable.
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
verdict_bit with fires_when true and no keyword restriction matches nearly every decision record
